description:
Resend / replay Interoperability messages via the pinned Ens.MessageHeader:ResendDuplicatedMessage API. Actions:

- **preview** (read, enabled by default): per header ID (1-100) — id, session, source/target item, status, time, body classname (+ existence check), a first-~1KB body summary under the operator's data policy (`IRIS_DATA_POLICY`, set per profile; default `redact`: an HL7 v2 body shows only its class name, every other body is withheld with a reason; `block` withholds every body; `allow` shows the summary unchanged), and a resendability verdict + reason (Request-type Status=Error headers are the correct retry target; Response-type error headers are flagged as likely a no-op). Never mutates.
- **resend** (write, DEFAULT-DISABLED): resend up to 100 explicit headerIds directly. Per-header result {originalId, newHeaderId?, ok, error?}; a bad header does not abort the batch.
- **resendFiltered** (write, DEFAULT-DISABLED): resend messages matching item + status (default 'Errored') + a from/to time window (max 7 days). DRY-RUN-FIRST WORKFLOW: dryRun defaults to true and returns only the match count + first-20 sample, resending NOTHING; executing requires BOTH dryRun:false AND confirm:true: dryRun:false without confirm:true is refused with no changes made, and leaving dryRun out previews again. maxMessages caps the batch (default 100, HARD CAP 500) — an executing call whose match count is over the cap is refused (not truncated-and-executed), while a preview reports the full count; narrow the window or item filter and retry.

GOVERNANCE — resend/resendFiltered are default-disabled writes (resend duplicates data flow downstream; it is not a last-resort recovery action like iris_production_control:clean). Enable via IRIS_GOVERNANCE, e.g.:
{"global": {"iris_message_resend:resend": true, "iris_message_resend:resendFiltered": true}}

DUPLICATION HAZARD: resending an already-processed message delivers its data again downstream — the target sees a brand-new message, not a correction. Always preview first and confirm the message is actually worth retrying (e.g. a genuinely failed Request, not a completed one).

HUMAN CONFIRMATION: when the MCP client supports form elicitation, 'resend' and an executing 'resendFiltered' (when its read-only preview matches 1 to maxMessages messages) also ask the person in a confirmation dialog, after every check above and right before anything is resent; only an accept with Confirm ticked proceeds, and a decline or a dismissal returns CONFIRMATION_DECLINED with nothing changed (do not repeat the call unless the person asks). A client without elicitation is not asked, and the call works as described above.

action.description: Action to perform: preview (read), resend or resendFiltered (writes, default-disabled)

confirm.description: (resendFiltered) Must be true together with dryRun:false to execute the resend; dryRun:false without confirm:true is refused with no changes made. Ignored while dryRun is true or omitted (the call previews).

dryRun.description: (resendFiltered) Default true: return count + a first-20 sample and resend NOTHING. Must be explicitly false (with confirm:true) to execute.

from.description: (resendFiltered, REQUIRED) Window start — ISO-8601 or ODBC timestamp. The from/to window may not exceed 7 days.

headOfQueue.description: (resend only) Enqueue the resent message at the head of its target queue (default: false).

headerIds.description: Header IDs (1-100 numeric values, string or number) — required for 'preview' and 'resend'. Ignored by 'resendFiltered'.

item.description: (resendFiltered, REQUIRED) Config item name — matches either the SourceConfigName or TargetConfigName of candidate messages.

maxMessages.description: (resendFiltered) Cap on matched/resent messages (default: 100, HARD CAP: 500). An executing call whose match count is over this cap is refused, not truncated-and-executed; a preview reports the full count.

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to operate on a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

to.description: (resendFiltered) Window end — ISO-8601 or ODBC timestamp (default: now).

name: iris_message_resend
title: Resend Interoperability Messages
